clips.title: The story
paras: Kreldig Ungor is an enterprising dwarven operative representing Reclaimers Inc., stationed high among the crags of Nijel's Point in Desolace. Tasked with managing field operations in the barren wasteland, he hires Alliance adventurers to recover lost cargo and secure valuable local reagents. His salvage and recovery contracts make him a central contact for travelers navigating the hostile region.

Nijel's Point offers the Alliance a rare sanctuary amid the blighted canyons of Desolace, making it an ideal staging ground for commercial opportunists like Kreldig Ungor. Representing Reclaimers Inc., Kreldig has ventured far from the safety of Khaz Modan into a desolate wilderness contested by centaur clans, demons, and the Horde. Where others see ruin and ash, Kreldig sees untapped profit and lost assets ripe for recovery.

A primary venture bringing Kreldig to Desolace involves the lost vessel of Karnitol, which wrecked along the treacherous western coast. Karnitol's shipment held prized goods, and Kreldig orchestrates efforts to track down the debris and retrieve the scattered cargo before scavengers or coastal sea giants can claim it all.

Beyond maritime salvage, Kreldig oversees the procurement of Desolace's strange biological and mineral treasures for Reclaimers Inc. The harsh environment breeds unique fauna and flora, whose parts fetch high prices among alchemists and engineers back in the Eastern Kingdoms. Adventurers willing to brave the wasteland's predators find steady pay beneath Kreldig's ledger.
